cards.flavor: The archangel that descends onto the stage. The singing voice that tempts spectators to heaven.

(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)

cards.title: Blessing of the Great Spirit
cards.kanji: G•Sの祝福
cards.effect: [CONT](GC):If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, this unit gets [Shield]+5000.

cards.title: Blessing of the Hell Dragon
cards.kanji: 奈落竜の冥加
cards.flavor: The age of myths. The hell dragon is granted despair and resolution.

cards.title: Blessing Owl
cards.kanji: ブレッシング・オウル
cards.flavor:
The young rebels set out on a journey to find
the legendary armor of the seven sacred beasts.
cards.effect: [AUTO]: When this unit is placed on (RC), choose another of your «Gold Paladin», and that unit gets [Power]+2000 until end of turn.

cards.title: Blest Dragon, Gabwelius
cards.kanji: 聖竜 ガブエリウス
cards.flavor: Even though it's just a glimmer of hope, a miracle will descend upon those who reach out their hand.

[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), COST [Soul Blast (1)], look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or bottom of the deck. If you put it on the bottom of the deck, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.

cards.title: Blink Messiah
cards.kanji: ブリンクメサイア
cards.flavor:
(G-BT05): Blink away, the world!
(G-CB06): The world gave a single answer.
cards.effect:
[AUTO](RC):When your grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Messiah" in its card name attacks, COST [put this unit into soul], draw a card, choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle.
[AUTO]:When this card is revealed for a damage check, draw a card.

cards.title: Blink Messiah (V Series)
cards.kanji: ブリンクメサイア
cards.flavor:
(V-BT08): The world seeks salvation, and the messiah responds to that voice.
(D-VS04): The light of salvation flickered across the world.

cards.title: Blinking Knight, Millius
cards.kanji: 瞬きの騎士 ミーリウス
cards.flavor: The enemy will first realize that they are pierced, when pain rushes.
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:Forerunner
[AUTO](RC):[Put this unit into your soul] When an attack hits during the battle that this unit boosted a unit with the brave ability, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at ten cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to two cards with "Altmile" in their card names from among them, put one of the revealed cards into your hand, put one of the revealed cards into your soul, and shuffle your deck. (If you only revealed one card, put it into your hand)

cards.title: Blinklock Dragon
cards.kanji: ブリンクロック・ドラゴン
cards.effect: [AUTO]:When this unit is put from (RC) into soul, COST [Counter Blast (1)], and draw a card.

cards.title: Blitz Accounting Department Head, Sordio
cards.kanji: ブリッツ経理部長 ゾルディオ
cards.flavor: The consequences of the CEO's recklessness usually fall upon the accounting department.

cards.title: Blitz Accounting Department Staff, Berjina
cards.kanji: ブリッツ経理部員 ベルヒナ
cards.flavor: Yes! Here are the prepared materials!

[AUTO](RC)1/Turn:When a Product in your order zone is operated by another card's ability, COST [Soul Blast (2)], and draw a card.

cards.title: Blitz Assistant, Sortien
cards.kanji: ブリッツアシスタント ゾアティン
cards.flavor: Supporting aspirations, the strength behind the scenes.

cards.title: Blitz Best Programmer, Strazer
cards.kanji: ブリッツベストプログラマー ストラーザ
cards.flavor: In the programs he writes, there isn't a single bug.
cards.effect: [AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Blitz Head Researcher, Uber", COST [Soul Blast (1)], search your deck for up to one Product card with grade less than or equal to your opponent's vanguard, reveal it and put it into hand, and shuffle the deck.

cards.title: Blitz Caliber Dragon
cards.kanji: ブリッツキャリバー・ドラゴン
cards.flavor: That one blow is like the thundering lightning.
cards.effect: [CONT](VC):During your turn, if any player's card was bound this turn, this unit gets [Power]+20000.

cards.title: Blitz Carrier, Turagen
cards.kanji: ブリッツキャリアー トゥラージェン
cards.flavor: We can't let this halt the flow of goods, right?

cards.title: Blitz CEO, Welstra
cards.kanji: ブリッツCEO ヴェルストラ
cards.flavor: An endless untrodden field. What I seek can be found there.
cards.effect:
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, choose one of your Products in your Order Zone, and operate it. (Activate its Operate ability)
[AUTO](VC):When one of your Products is operated, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

cards.title: Blitz Chaser, Laufen
cards.kanji: ブリッツチェイサー ラウフェン
cards.flavor: Persistently, relentlessly, and tenaciously tracking.
cards.effect: [AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts, if it is the third battle of this turn or more, COST [Counter Blast (1) & Energy Blast (2)], draw a card, and this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of battle.

cards.title: Blitz Chaser, Laufen (No Ability)
cards.kanji: ブリッツチェイサー ラウフェン
cards.flavor: Persistently, relentlessly, and tenaciously tracking.

cards.title: Blitz Chief Mechanic, Warton
cards.kanji: ブリッツチーフメカニック バートン

cards.title: Blitz Chief Mechanic, Warton (No Ability)
cards.kanji: ブリッツチーフメカニック バートン
cards.flavor: If there's something you don't understand, just ask me. That's your first task.

cards.title: Blitz Customer Support, Kurde
cards.kanji: ブリッツカスタマーサポート クルディ
cards.flavor: Her incredible support even puts a smile on the faces of complainers.
cards.effect:
[CONT](RC):During the battle this unit boosted, if you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Welstra" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Welstra" in its card name, Energy Charge (1).

cards.title: Blitz Designer, Geed
cards.kanji: ブリッツデザイナー ギード
cards.flavor: Hehe... The elegant shape of this form... A steel surface... The scent of violent atrocity emitting from the surface! This is a product I designed from start to finish, an unspoiled masterpiece. And to have fit everything within this size? Splendid, if I do say so myself. It's perfect. Well done. Good job!
cards.effect: (When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

cards.title: Blitz Designer, Razent
cards.kanji: ブリッツデザイナー ラーツェント
cards.flavor: Do this here... then like that♪ Yeah, looking good~!
cards.effect:
[AUTO](Drop):When your Product is operated, if you have a vanguard with "Blitz" in its card name, perform one of the following.
•If all of your rear-guards have different card names from this card, call this card to a back row (RC).
•COST [Bind this card], Energy Charge (2), and until end of turn, you cannot pay the cost of the [AUTO] abilities of a card with the same card name as this card.
[CONT](RC):If you have a vanguard with "Blitz" in its card name, this unit gets "Intercept", and can intercept from the back row.

cards.title: Blitz Doctor, Gesund
cards.kanji: ブリッツドクター ゲイズン
cards.flavor: I understand that work can be fun, but it's no good to get sick.
cards.effect: (You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

cards.title: Blitz Engineer, Hoflio
cards.kanji: ブリッツエンジニア ヘイリオ
cards.flavor: 100% customer satisfaction starts with a detailed after-service.
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), if you did not operate a Product this turn, COST [Counter Blast (1) & Soul Blast (1)], choose a Product card in your Order Zone, and operate it. (Activate its Operate ability)
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you operated a Product this turn, this unit gets [Power]+5000

cards.title: Blitz Fleet Admiral, Welstra "Fantôme"
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊提督 ヴェルストラ “幻影”
cards.flavor: Now we advance toward the distant mark. Fleet, Unmoor――!
cards.effect:
[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your battle phase, COST [Soul Blast up to the same number of cards as your opponent's vanguard's grade], choose the same number of your rear-guards with the Unmoor ability as the number of cards Soul Blast for this cost, and unmoor them. (Activate their Unmoor ability)
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, COST [Counter Blast (1)], choose up to two columns with two of your rear-guards, and switch all of your rear-guards in the chosen columns between the front and back rows. If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, all of your front row units get [Power]+5000 until end of turn. (They all move simultaneously, and switch within the same column)
[Fantôme Skill] - [ACT](VC)1/Turn:COST [Bind a Crimson Moon card from hand, soul, or drop], choose a <Tear Dragon> or <Aquaroid> from your drop, and call it to (RC).

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Anshteur Dragon
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 アンシュテーア・ドラゴン
cards.flavor: Charge at maximum speed!

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Fairvaines Dragon
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 フェアヴァイネス・ドラゴン
cards.flavor: Without leaving a single opening, they sank the swarming enemy forces.
cards.effect: Unmoor - [AUTO](RC):When this unit unmoors, COST [Counter Blast (1)], and this unit gets "[CONT](RC):When this unit would attack, it battles all of your opponent's front row units." until end of turn.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Folderst Dragon
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 フォルダースト・ドラゴン
cards.flavor: As I suspected. The exhilaration of being on the front lines is irreplaceable.
cards.effect:
[CONT](RC/GC):If you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Welstra" in its card name, this unit gets "[AUTO]:When this unit is retired from (GC), you may put this card into soul.", and [Shield]+5000. Unmoor - [AUTO](RC):When this unit unmoors, all of your units in the same column as this unit get [Power]+5000 until end of turn.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Ginauth
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 ギナウス

At the end of that turn, you may put this unit into soul.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Omdirei Dragon
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 オムディーレイ・ドラゴン

[AUTO](RC)1/Turn:When your other rear-guard in the same column as this unit attacks, that unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Perfe
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 ペルフェ

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Raffinir Dragon
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 ラフィニール・ドラゴン

[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), if you have a vanguard with "Blitz Fleet" in its card name, look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to one <Tear Dragon> or <Aquaroid> from among them, discard it, and shuffle the deck.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Schussei
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 シューゼ

Unmoor - [ACT](RC):When this unit unmoors, until end of your opponent's next turn, this unit gets "[AUTO](RC):When this unit is moved to the back row by your vanguard's ability, choose one of your rear-guards in the same column as this unit, and it gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.", and can intercept from the back row.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Strazer
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 ストラーザ

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Uber
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 ユーバ
cards.flavor: Fatal wound? That's what you call a scratch. It'll heal in no time.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Uvestei Dragon

If you revealed a card, or you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Welstra" in its card name, COST [Counter Blast (1)], look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one <Tear Dragon> or <Aquaroid> with grade less than or equal to your vanguard and a different card name from this unit from among them, call it to (RC), and shuffle the deck. Unmoor - [ACT](RC):When this unit unmoors, choose one of your opponent's vanguards, and it gets [Power]-5000 until end of turn.

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Warton
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 バートン

cards.title: Blitz Fleet, Zweig
cards.kanji: 征標艦隊 ツーヴェイク

cards.title: Blitz Head Researcher, Uber
cards.kanji: ブリッツ主任研究員 ユーバ

[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, COST [Energy Blast (3)], choose a Product from your order zone, and operate it.
[AUTO]:When this unit is ride upon by a unit with "Welstra" in its card name with [Divine Skill], if your order zone has a Product, COST [Soul Blast (1) & discard a card from hand], search your deck for up to two Product cards with different card names from each other and from cards in your order zone, reveal them and put them into hand, and shuffle the deck. (You may search for only one too)

cards.title: Blitz Interrupter
cards.kanji: ブリッツ・インタラプター

cards.flavor: Arm strength is important because it can help load supplies faster.

cards.title: Blitz Knuckle Dragon

•Choose one of your opponent's units, and it gets [Critical]-2 until end of that battle.

cards.title: Blitz Mechanic, Bauen

cards.kanji: ブリッツメカニック シュタルト

cards.effect: [ACT](RC):If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, COST [Counter Blast (1) & put a "Heavy Strike Cannon Fortress, Freischutz" from your Order Zone into your drop & retire this unit], choose up to one "Mobile Fortress of Obliteration, Freischutz Maximum" from your hand, and put it into your Order Zone.

[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have a vanguard with "Welstra" in its card name with [Divine Skill], COST [Counter Blast (1)], choose a Product from your order zone, and operate it.
